author: Telos I
title: AOS Hotfix: Execute Final Patch Script
abstract: Executing the hotfix_113.py script, written with the correct Indentation Protocol, to finally repair the monolithic aos_manager.py module.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
print("Executing hotfix script from storage/telos/hotfix_113.py...")
result = subprocess.run(['python', 'storage/telos/hotfix_113.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0:
  raise Exception("Hotfix script failed to execute properly.")
print("Hotfix script executed successfully.")
